recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No source follow-up is needed for FHIR-16101 unless the work group later chooses to make a purely editorial typo cleanup outside this issue-reconciliation threshold.
issue_request: FHIR-16101 was a Published/Persuasive OO change request asking BiologicallyDerivedProduct.parent to include an example showing one parent BiologicallyDerivedProduct spanning a multi-day PBSC donation with multiple child bag products, each with its own identifier.
initial_application: The Jira comments record commit b4bd0b1 as the application. That commit did not name FHIR-16101 in its subject, but it changed the old BDP spreadsheet parent comment from the generic "For products that have multiple collections" to the PBSC multi-day donation and parent-donation example. Later source conversion and BDP rework commits moved the content into the current StructureDefinition and retained the parent relationship as 0..* Reference(BiologicallyDerivedProduct).
additional_context: BiologicallyDerivedProduct is active in source/fhir.ini and the current authoritative source is source/biologicallyderivedproduct/structuredefinition-BiologicallyDerivedProduct.xml. The current parent element includes the PBSC example, links children to a parent donation, and permits multiple parent references with targetProfile BiologicallyDerivedProduct. The related 2018 OO Zulip thread repeats Jane Pollack's FHIR-16101 rationale; Confluence searches found no conflicting minutes or references. The remaining wording issue is a small typo ("split into in multiple containers"), which does not change implementer understanding enough to justify a reconciliation source edit.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit with no source changes because the current source already carries the requested example and relationship semantics.
